Name: Tractor Mod
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Buy a tractor to more efficiently work with crops, clear twigs and rocks, etc.
Description:
This mod lets you buy a tractor (and tractor garage) to more efficiently work with crops, clear twigs and rocks, etc:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/TractorMod/docs/screenshots/tractor.png)

**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods)).**

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)

Buy the tractor garage (with included tractor) from Robin and wait until she's done building it. Then just get on the tractor, choose a tool or seeds or fertilizer, and drive. You can also press `backspace` (configurable) to summon the tractor to your current position.

These tool features are enabled by default:
* **Axe** clears twigs / weeds / dead crops.
* **Fertiliser** fertilises crops and trees.
* **Grass Starters** plant grass.
* **Hoe** tills dirt, digs artifact spots, and clears weeds.
* **Melee weapons** clear dead crops and break mine containers.
* **Milk pail** collects milk from farm animals.
* **Pickaxe** ﻿breaks rocks, and clears weeds / dead crops / tilled dirt.
* **Scythe** harvests crops / bushes / flowers / forage / fruit trees / long grass, and clears weeds / dead crops.
* **Seeds** plant seeds in dirt.
* **Watering can** waters crops.

These features are disabled by default (you can enable each feature by [editing the config.json](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/TractorMod#configure)):
* **Axe** can chop trees or clear crops, and clear live crops.
* **Melee weapons** can attack monsters. This is overpowered and not recommended if you want a balanced playthrough.
* **Pickaxe** can break flooring/paths, and break placed objects.
* **Scythe** can collect machine output.
* **Slingshots** fire one projectile/tile/second in the aimed direction (that's nine projectiles per second by default). This is hugely overpowered, but will consume ammo at a voracious rate.

You can optionally change how the mod works:
* [change the tractor textures](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/TractorMod#custom-textures) (including seasonal textures);
* [edit the mod settings](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/TractorMod#configure) to change controller/keyboard/mouse mapping, the area of effect, tractor speed, custom tools, how much the tractor costs, etc;
* ﻿with [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) installed, you can also configure it through the ⚙ button on the title screen (see [example screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/TractorMod/docs/screenshots/generic-config-menu.png)).

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
Compatible with...
 * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
 * Linux, macOS, and Windows;
 * single-player and multiplayer. In multiplayer mode it must be installed by the main player, and any farmhands that want to use the tractor features. Farmhands who don't have it installed won't have any issues, they just won't see the tractor textures or be able to use its features.

Pairs well with:
* [Pony Weight Loss Program](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1232) (works with the tractor too);
* [Tractor Engine Sound﻿](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5781);
* [Tractor Remodel](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6001).

Mod conflicts:
* [Farm Expansion](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/130): compatible, but **do not** build the garage in the expansion area. You can use the tractor there, but make sure not to leave it there overnight.
* [Save Anywhere](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/444)﻿: not compatible. That mod bypasses SMAPI's save events, so this mod (and many others) can't correctly remove its custom data before save.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
